nativeControls.name: Museo de Arte de Lima – Palacio de la Exposición

scope: The standing Palacio de la Exposición in Lima housing the Museo de Arte de Lima, with two projecting pavilions, restored neorenaissance elevations and central courtyard.

imagerySearch.result: The Qualla gallery contains public-domain collection objects and historic photographs of other places. The architecture references in the gallery carry attribution licenses or show objects and interiors.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: Official museum identity, Italian neo-Renaissance design by Antonio Leonardi and pioneering use of imported iron columns.

The preservation report identifies the four elevations, restored plaster cornices and ornament, wooden upper balustrades, the notable wooden pediment facing Paseo Colón and the principal visitor entry facing the park. Written record only.
Palace record links the distinct museum entity and explicitly names the same native OSM way.
Historical survey confirms two floors, the central courtyard and rectangular palace.
The architectural study describes a 25 m square central courtyard.
